plain_description.what: On matches where the models disagree, it gives the judge two reference answers instead of the single strongest one (about 1,400 calls).
plain_description.why: It tests whether adding a second reference improves judge accuracy.
plain_description.information: A gain would argue for multi-reference judging. Result: null, with a negative direction. Two references scored 0.748 against 0.774 with the best single reference (not significant). The second reference dilutes a good one and helps only when the second model was right. One strongest reference only, and this line is closed. A later ruling classes this run's judged data as history, not evidence.
